notes: Lane E owns the 16 non-skipped items with layer buildx or cli-only, including the three docker_stack items (cli-only:stack, cli-only:stack-services, cli-only:stacks; coordinator assignment). cli-only:context, cli-only:login, cli-only:stack-config, cli-only:stack-ps and buildx:version are kind skip, so they get no outputs (contexts' TLSMaterial and login auth are therefore not covered here).
buildx_version is the SOURCES.md pin (buildx v0.38.2) of the buildx semantics a type mirrors; the provider never runs buildx, so it is static, not discovered at runtime.

Builder field names: `docker buildx ls --format` documents .Name/.DriverEndpoint/.LastActivity/.Status/.Buildkit/.Platforms/.Error/.Builder (and .Builder.Name, .Builder.Nodes, node .Name/.Endpoint). The other builder/node fields (Driver Options, Flags, Labels, GC Policy) are recorded with their `docker buildx inspect` text label (`label`), because the harvested docs do not show their JSON keys.
FIELD entries carry `format_field` (Go template placeholder), `label` (pretty/text label), `pointer` (swagger) or `anchor` (doc) as their upstream locator.
docker_registry_image_manifests is the target of two items (buildx:imagetools-inspect, cli-only:manifest-inspect); both get the identical output list.
buildx:stop status is category structured with a one-field list so the action has a typed result; actions have no V2 requirement.
PARITY docker buildx inspect: covered=16 gaps=manually-pinned platform marker (*), --debug extra view
PARITY docker buildx ls --format: covered=8 gaps=none (current-builder * marker is client-side state, not a placeholder)
PARITY docker buildx du --format: covered=11 gaps=none (plus Shared/Private/Reclaimable/Total summary covered)
PARITY docker buildx history ls --format json: covered=5 gaps=none
PARITY docker buildx history inspect --format json: covered=19 gaps=attachment bodies (history inspect attachment)
PARITY docker buildx imagetools inspect --format: covered=5 gaps=none (.Name .Manifest .Image .Provenance .SBOM)
PARITY docker manifest inspect [--verbose]: covered=9 gaps=child manifest bodies of a list in --verbose (per-platform config/layers)
PARITY docker buildx bake --print: covered=32 gaps=none (group, target and all 30 target attributes; --metadata-file keys covered by metadata)
PARITY docker buildx build --metadata-file: covered=6 gaps=none
PARITY docker stack ls --format: covered=4 gaps=none
PARITY docker stack services --format: covered=6 gaps=none
PARITY docker stack ps --format: covered=8 gaps=none (via docker_stack data source `tasks`; cli-only:stack-ps itself is skipped)

cli-only:stack `stack` follows compose-spec #/$defs/service (allOf service + container_spec + workload_spec, 94 top-level keys); nested compose objects (deploy, build, healthcheck, networks, ...) are dynamic under the mechanical rule.
naming_questions: docker_stack data source structured output: `services` + `tasks` (current) or split tasks into docker_tasks only and drop `tasks` here?

stack ls Services count: `services` in docker_stacks (upstream name) while docker_stack.stack.services is the compose service map; rename the docker_stacks field to `services_count`, or keep upstream `services`?
